title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave amid security scandal and AI concerns
digest:
Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet announced plans to step down by the end of 2026, citing the need to address AI-driven security threats and the aftermath of a spyware attack that caused over $10.5 million in losses and multiple lawsuits (Protos, 2026-11-20).

Guillemet led Ledger's transformation from a startup to a unicorn company over nine years, establishing its cybersecurity framework (Donjon team) and launching core products like hardware wallets (Protos, 2026-11-20).

The departure coincides with an ongoing legal dispute over data breaches and a public acknowledgment that the security challenges he helped define now apply broadly to all industries due to AI advancements (Protos, 2026-11-20).
